Order Number

Kind regards,

turns.q: Can I cancel an order after placing it, and is there a time window?
turns.replyTail:
I would be more than happy to help you with your cancellation request.

To check if your order is eligible for cancellation, could you please provide the following details:

Order Name
Order Email Address
Order Number
Item(s) on the order

Once I have this information, I can look into the status of your order for you. ✨

turns.q: Can I add an item to an order I already placed?
turns.replyTail:
I understand you would like to add an item to your order.

Unfortunately, once an order has been placed, we are unable to add items or make any changes to the order details. If you would like to purchase additional items, please feel free to place a new order on our website.

If you have any other questions, please let me know. ✨

turns.q: What happens if it already shipped, can it still be changed?
turns.replyTail:
Once an order has been shipped, it is unfortunately too late to make any changes or cancellations.

If you have changed your mind about your order, please accept the delivery and create a return request through our normal returns flow once it arrives. ✨
